Overview

Virtual Customer Care, explained

Every missed call or slow reply is a customer who might go elsewhere. Hiring and training extra staff for busy periods is expensive.

Our trained virtual agents answer your calls, chats and emails using your scripts and processes. They take messages, answer common questions and pass urgent matters to your team, so customers always reach a real person.

Who it's for

  • Businesses missing calls during busy times
  • Small teams that can't always answer
  • Businesses wanting after-hours cover
  • Companies handling seasonal peaks

Why it matters

Why Virtual Customer Care matters for your business

Customers expect quick answers. If calls go to voicemail or emails sit unanswered, many will try a competitor instead.

Hiring and training staff for peaks and after-hours cover is expensive. Virtual customer care gives you trained agents when you need them.

Our agents answer in your business name, follow your scripts and pass urgent matters straight to your team.

At a glance

  • Fixed written quote in AUD or USD
  • One account manager
  • Available worldwide, in English
  • Support 24/7

How it works

From first call to done, in four steps

  1. Needs check

    We look at how customers contact you and where calls get missed.

  2. Fixed quote

    Numbers, features and call flows, quoted in writing.

  3. Setup

    We configure everything and move existing numbers where possible.

  4. Go live & support

    We test with you, then stay on hand to adjust.

Pricing

What affects the cost of Virtual Customer Care

  • How many numbers and users you need
  • Whether you're keeping existing numbers or getting new ones
  • Call flow complexity, such as menus, queues and after-hours rules
  • Handsets, if you want desk phones
  • For customer care: the hours, channels and call volumes to cover

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Get a fixed quote

Getting started

What we'll need from you

  • Your current phone numbers and provider details
  • Who should answer which calls, and when
  • Your business hours and holiday periods

FAQ

Virtual Customer Care questions

Do agents know our business?

We train them on your products, scripts and processes before go-live.

Can it cover after-hours only?

Yes. Coverage can be full-time, overflow or after-hours.

Will customers know it's an outside team?

Agents answer in your business name and follow your scripts.

How do agents get urgent issues to us?

We agree escalation rules and contacts with you before go-live.

Can we start with overflow only?

Yes. Many clients start with overflow or after-hours cover.

Can agents take bookings?

Yes, if they have access to your booking system.

What hours can you cover?

Cover can be business hours, after hours or overflow, agreed in your quote.

Can agents handle live chat and email too?

Yes, across calls, chat and email.
